workspace.description: Local directory for transcript, brief, matrix, and draft versions.

offline.description: Use mock streaming models; no network calls.

gateway.description: Shared local multi-key gateway. Models inherit base_url and api_key unless they override.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions root. Live defaults are per-model (xixiapi.io / openrouter.ai) via config.example.yaml and opencode.json. Optional backup is grok2api on loopback (PRD_AI_GATEWAY_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1) speaking grok-4.5 / grok-composer-2.5-fast — not Claude. Do not commit API keys.

api_key.description: Gateway key, usually ${PRD_AI_GATEWAY_KEY:-}. Prefer env interpolation over plaintext.

id.description: Stable label shown on chat bubbles (not necessarily the vendor model id).

base_url.description: Optional per-model override of gateway.base_url. Resolved from config + env. Empty means inherit the gateway.

api_key.description: Optional per-model key or ${ENV} interpolation. Empty means inherit gateway.api_key.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable name for the key (PRD_SFP_XIXI_KEY, PRD_SFP_OPENROUTER_KEY, PRD_AI_GATEWAY_KEY, or optional PRD_CODEX_KEY / PRD_GEMINI_KEY / PRD_XAI_KEY / PRD_CLAUDE_CODE_KEY). Never commit the value.

model.description: Model id sent in the Chat Completions body (whatever the gateway expects).

transport.description: http = OpenAI-compat base_url + env key. cli = Mac-local Codex / Claude Code / Antigravity / Gemini / Grok binary.

command.description: When transport=cli: preset or argv (`codex`, `claude`, `antigravity`/`agy`, `gemini`, `grok`). Missing binary is reported, not a crash.
